note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000. Conscription ended in 1973; men must still register with the Selective Service, which is modelled as a volunteer force. Religion: the First Amendment bars an established church, but religion is not excluded from public life, so pluralist secularism is used. Internet: lawful intercept with judicial oversight (pre-2001). Healthcare: mostly employer-based private insurance with public safety nets (Medicare, Medicaid). Immigration: quota and sponsorship system.
